3 Sprints Completed
~840 Team Hours
8+ Epics Delivered
We believe the future of healthcare isn't in a waiting room — it's in virtual reality. MedMeet reimagines remote medical consultations: doctors and patients meet in an immersive VR environment with AI assistance, real-time sign language translation, 3D interactive anatomy, surgery simulations, laser annotation tools, session recording, document sharing, and an AI smart assistant — all in one platform. Built by students. Designed for the future of healthcare.

Sprint Journey — What We Built
1
Sprint 1 — Foundation
Oct – Dec 2025 · ~270 hrs · MVP: Basic VR Meeting
  • Basic VR meeting room — up to 5 simultaneous participants
  • Avatar system — every user visually represented in 3D
  • Real-time VoIP voice communication with mute/unmute
  • Session join/leave with live participant list
  • Shared 3D medical model (heart, brain, lungs) visible to all
  • Automatic attendance & event logging exported to CSV
  • Integration & stability testing — full demo-ready system
2
Sprint 2 — Advanced Features
Dec 2025 – Jan 2026 · ~280 hrs · MVP: AI + Interaction
  • Multi-room system with interactive doors & room status indicators
  • 360° 3D model rotation, zoom & model gallery (4+ organs)
  • Laser pointer + persistent paint annotations shared between users
  • Medical image upload & display: PNG / JPG / X-Ray + gallery
  • AI session transcription via Whisper/Google API — export to TXT/PDF
  • People Analytics — talk time & participation percentage per user
  • Full 3D session recording with avatar playback in Unity
  • Improved avatars: hand tracking, walk & sit animations
  • AR Passthrough Mode (Quest 3) — stretch goal
3
Sprint 3 — Innovation & Polish
Mar – Jun 2026 · ~280 hrs · MVP: Training + Accessibility
  • Interactive human body — click organs to view 3D info, remove & replace
  • Surgery simulation — cut open a chest with a scalpel & explore organs
  • Real-time sign language avatar (AI speech-to-sign translation)
  • Surgery training rooms: heart, lung & brain step-by-step tutorials
  • Medical learning center with interactive knowledge panels & slides
  • AI smart assistant (GPT/Grok) — voice & text Q&A mid-session
  • Voice commands for hands-free navigation & system control
  • Avatar movement sync: hand IK, head tracking & walking
  • System-wide polish, bug fixes & full stability QA
  • Social impact showcase — CO₂ savings, accessibility & sustainability
